notes: Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue convention: the visual upper half (rows f-j) is bank 'b', so holes are written like '4b.g'.

Pin 9 -> orange wire -> column 4; 220 ohm resistor spans columns 4 and 6 in row h; LED anode (bent, longer leg) in column 6, cathode in column 8; black wire from column 8 to the Uno GND pin next to pin 13 (GND.1 assumed).
Resistor column positions were read from the image; the left end of the resistor aligns with the orange wire's column 4.
The Claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors need authorization (via claude.ai connector settings) before they can be used; they are not needed for this graph.
